segment.source: You are supposed to greet a Tchortist with "Tchort is evolution," not "hey, there." Just so you know for future reference $(#brother/sister), or someone might take offense.<end>

segment.source: I am Rassophore Payam and I am in charge of monitoring and security. What can I do for you?<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.target: Tchort guide you too, brother.<end>

segment.source: I need to leave the Institute building.<end>
segment.target: I need to leave the Institute building.<end>

segment.source: What is the reason for your egress, $(#brother/sister)?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.target: Official business? On whose authority?<end>

segment.source: Principal Investigator Rista.<end>

segment.target: Yes, I have been informed of that, $(#brother/sister).<end>

segment.source: Oh, and I might need to take several trips back and forth.<end>

segment.source: Uh...<end>

segment.source: I don't know anyone called "Uh." In fact, I should warn you not to give false statements concerning your egress.<end>
segment.target: I don't know anyone called "Uh." In fact, I should warn you not to give false statements concerning your egress.<end>

segment.source: It's a private matter.<end>

segment.source: Please answer my question, $(#brother/sister); I'm simply following the proper procedure.<end>
segment.target: Please answer my question, $(#brother/sister); I'm simply following the proper procedure.<end>

segment.source: Are you in charge of opening the main gate?<end>
segment.target: Are you in charge of opening the main gate?<end>

segment.source: Yes, that is correct. All arrivals and departures are carefully monitored from this very room and if you, for instance, wished to leave the building, you'd have to use that intercom there and state the reason for your movement.<end>
segment.target: Yes, that is correct. All arrivals and departures are carefully monitored from this very room and if you, for instance, wished to leave the building, you'd have to use that intercom there and state the reason for your movement.<end>

segment.source: So every time someone wants to enter or leave has to answer to you?<end>
segment.target: So every time someone wants to enter or leave has to answer to you?<end>

segment.source: Well, I am most certainly not going to question notability regarding their reasons for leaving or entering the Institute building; magnificent Tchort, no. But we can't have, for instance, a novitiate like you simply stroll in and out however $(#he/she) pleases without answering to anyone.<end>
segment.target: Well, I am most certainly not going to question notability regarding their reasons for leaving or entering the Institute building; magnificent Tchort, no. But we can't have, for instance, a novitiate like you simply stroll in and out however $(#he/she) pleases without answering to anyone.<end>

segment.source: The procedures are there to be followed and respected, and if it is bothering you, you better adapt to it.<end>
segment.target: The procedures are there to be followed and respected, and if it is bothering you, you better adapt to it.<end>

segment.source: Gotcha. Now let me ask you something else.<end>
segment.target: Gotcha. Now let me ask you something else.<end>

segment.target: Right, but keep it short, $(#brother/sister).<end>

segment.source: I would like to ask you several questions about Tchortism.<end>
segment.target: I would like to ask you several questions about Tchortism.<end>

segment.source: I am sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. My recommendation would be to either visit Eidein's Library or talk to someone from Propagation - Praepostor Amelia, for instance.<end>
segment.target: I am sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. My recommendation would be to either visit Eidein's Library or talk to someone from Propagation - Praepostor Amelia, for instance.<end>

segment.source: Of course, reading the Original Report should be your priority, if you haven't done so already. Anything else?<end>
segment.target: Of course, reading the Original Report should be your priority, if you haven't done so already. Anything else?<end>

segment.source: What does a cell about to undergo mitosis say to an interested investigator? "I hope I have your divided attention!"<end>

Excuse me, $(#brother/sister)? Why are you telling me this?<end>

::Your statement is met with a statue-like stillness. The awkward moment doesn't last long, however.::
